# Gaurav Kumar

> Software developer building scalable backend systems, web applications, and developer tools using TypeScript, Node.js, Next.js, and Go.

Gaurav Kumar (online handle: `itstheanurag`) is a software developer with ~3 years of production engineering experience, specializing in backend architecture, API design, distributed systems, and developer tooling. He has extensive domain experience in healthcare technology, building HIPAA-conscious platforms, real-time messaging, clinician dashboards, and third-party integrations (ModMed EMR, Square Payments, Google Cloud Platform, Firebase).

Website: https://itsanurag.in
Location: India (Open to remote roles and freelance opportunities)
Primary Focus: Backend Engineering, Distributed Systems, Web Applications, Developer Tooling

## Featured Open Source & Developer Tools

- [Hanma](https://hanma-a2n.pages.dev/): A backend tooling platform and registry for Node.js and Bun, providing modular, copy-pasteable production backend snippets (logging, auth, middleware, CORS) and a companion CLI.
- [Scaffoldor](https://scaffoldor.vercel.app/): An open-source discovery platform and CLI to search, clone, and bootstrap production starter templates from GitHub and GitLab without commit bloat.
- [Keyway](https://keyway.onrender.com/): Peer-to-peer browser-based file transfer application built with WebRTC and client-side encryption. Transfers files directly between devices without intermediate server storage.
- [CodeCript](https://codecript.pages.dev/): An open-source technical education platform covering TypeScript, Go, data structures, algorithms, and system design.
- [Bits & Pieces](https://github.com/itstheanurag/bitsandpieces): Modern React/Next.js UI component library featuring clean micro-interactions and animations with Framer Motion.

## Healthcare & Enterprise Systems

- [Cadence](https://play.google.com/store/apps/details?id=com.ntu.cadence): Research-driven cardiovascular health application built in collaboration with Nanyang Technological University (NTU). Features real-time clinician-patient messaging, biometric tracking (sleep, steps, vitals), action scores, and BigQuery research analytics pipelines.
- [Schweiger Allergy / SDG](https://play.google.com/store/apps/details?id=com.mahalo.Schweiger): High-scale patient engagement application with ModMed EMR integration, Square payment processing, GCP Pub/Sub asynchronous event-driven pipelines, and Socket.IO chat.
- [MedLinks](https://play.google.com/store/apps/details?id=com.mahalo.medlinksclinician): Clinical dashboard and patient adherence platform with automated vitals monitoring, personalized health programs, and notifications.

## NPM Packages

- [hanma](https://www.npmjs.com/package/hanma): CLI tool for scaffolding backend snippets and templates directly into Node.js/Bun codebases (`npm install -g hanma`).
- [scaffoldor](https://www.npmjs.com/package/scaffoldor): Universal starter repository downloader and project scaffolder (`npm install -g scaffoldor`).

## Technical Competencies

- Languages: TypeScript, JavaScript, Go, SQL, HTML, CSS
- Backend & Frameworks: Node.js, NestJS, Express, Hono, Bun, REST APIs, WebSockets, Socket.IO
- Databases & ORMs: PostgreSQL, MongoDB, Redis, Sequelize, Drizzle, Prisma
- Cloud & Infrastructure: Google Cloud Platform (GCP), Pub/Sub, BigQuery, Firebase, Cloudflare, Docker, Vercel
- Frontend & UI: Next.js, React, Tailwind CSS, Framer Motion, Vite
